notes: Snapshot of rosters. Age is calculated from birthDate automatically. Stats are 1-150 ratings (see README for how each sport maps). 'comp' is a Gen 1 (#1-151) Pokemon comparison shown only after the puzzle ends.

athletes.name: Shohei Ohtani
athletes.bio: A creature thought to be impossible. It hurls fire from the mound, then picks up a bat and launches the ball into orbit. Scholars still argue over which talent is its true form.

comp.name: Mew
comp.why: Said to know every move. Pitches and hits at an MVP level.

athletes.name: Aaron Judge
athletes.bio: It stands six-foot-seven and leads its pack with quiet authority. When it connects, the crowd rises before the ball even lands.

comp.name: Machamp
comp.why: Pure, overwhelming power with the discipline to match.

athletes.name: Juan Soto
athletes.bio: It reads every pitch before it leaves the hand. When it takes a ball, it shuffles its feet at the pitcher as if to say it knew all along.

comp.name: Starmie
comp.why: Its glowing core analyzes everything. Elite eye at the plate.

athletes.name: Mookie Betts
athletes.bio: Small in stature but able to master any role it is given. It has won awards in the outfield and then moved to the infield without missing a beat.

comp.name: Ditto
comp.why: Transforms into whatever the team needs: outfield, second base, shortstop.

athletes.name: Bobby Witt Jr.
athletes.bio: It turns ordinary doubles into triples in a crackling blur. Its sprint speed is so high that infielders rush their throws just hearing it run.

comp.name: Jolteon
comp.why: Speed charged with electricity, plus sharp defense.

athletes.name: Elly De La Cruz
athletes.bio: Its throws across the diamond have been clocked faster than most fastballs. Every time it reaches base, the whole ballpark braces for a storm.

comp.name: Electabuzz
comp.why: Wild, crackling, raw tools that light up any game.

athletes.name: Paul Skenes
athletes.bio: It fires pitches over 100 mph and then drops a splitter that vanishes in mid-air. It trained in a military academy before taking over big-league mounds.

comp.name: Charizard
comp.why: Breathes fire. Becomes an ace almost instantly.

athletes.name: Garrett Crochet
athletes.bio: A towering left-hander that freezes hitters in place. It piles up strikeouts so steadily that opponents are snowed under by the fifth inning.

comp.name: Dewgong
comp.why: Sleek, cold, and thrives in a chilly northeastern home.

athletes.name: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.
athletes.bio: Its father was a legend of the same kind. It smashes line drives so hard that infielders flinch, and it rarely swings and misses.

comp.name: Golem
comp.why: A solid boulder that hits the ball like a rockslide.

athletes.name: Cal Raleigh
athletes.bio: It crouches behind the plate wearing armor all game, then stands up and hits home runs like no catcher before it. Rivals call it by a nickname we can't print here.

comp.name: Kangaskhan
comp.why: A tough, protective guardian of its pitching staff.

athletes.name: José Ramírez
athletes.bio: It hits from both sides of the plate and plays every inning like it's the last. Compact and tireless, it digs in and refuses to be moved.

comp.name: Sandslash
comp.why: Compact, tough, and always digging in.

athletes.name: Francisco Lindor
athletes.bio: Its grin is famous across the league, and its colorful hair changes with the seasons. Behind the charm is a switch-hitting shortstop who rarely leaves the lineup.

comp.name: Clefable
comp.why: Charming, beloved, and much tougher than it looks.

athletes.name: Corbin Carroll
athletes.bio: It leads the league in triples by gliding around the bases like a desert wind. Small but fearless, it plays far bigger than its size.

comp.name: Pidgeot
comp.why: Swift flier that covers ground in a heartbeat.

athletes.name: Julio Rodríguez
athletes.bio: It soars across center field and snatches home runs out of the sky. Off the field it is a magnetic showman with a flair for style.

comp.name: Aerodactyl
comp.why: An ancient sky predator that robs fly balls.

athletes.name: Fernando Tatis Jr.
athletes.bio: It plays with flair, flipping bats and laser-throwing runners out from right field. Its father was also a big-league star with a famous swing.

comp.name: Arcanine
comp.why: Majestic, athletic, and fiery.

athletes.name: Gunnar Henderson
athletes.bio: A smooth left-handed swing flows out of this tall shortstop like a current. It grew up in the rural South before washing over the league as a young star.

comp.name: Wartortle
comp.why: Smooth, powerful, and still evolving.

athletes.name: Bryce Harper
athletes.bio: Since its teenage years it was called the chosen one. It thrives in the loudest moments, and its home crowd roars every time it steps in.

comp.name: Moltres
comp.why: A legendary blaze that rises again in big moments.

athletes.name: Yordan Alvarez
athletes.bio: Huge and completely calm, it barely seems to move until the bat whips through the zone. Its October home runs are the stuff of legend.

comp.name: Snorlax
comp.why: Enormous, relaxed, and devastating once it wakes up.

athletes.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
athletes.bio: It once did something no one had ever done: dozens of homers and over seventy steals in one season. Every swing and every step crackles with energy.

comp.name: Raichu
comp.why: Explosive power stored in a small, speedy frame.

athletes.name: Yoshinobu Yamamoto
athletes.bio: Not big for an ace, but it carries a whole arsenal of pitches and commands each one perfectly. It once dominated the biggest stage, winning game after game.

comp.name: Ninetales
comp.why: Each tail is a different pitch. Mystical and precise.

athletes.name: Nikola Jokić
athletes.bio: It looks slow and unbothered, yet it sees passing lanes no one else can. Away from the court it is happiest racing horses back home.

comp.name: Slowbro
comp.why: Looks sleepy, then bends the game with its mind.

athletes.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
athletes.bio: It slips past defenders with herky-jerky footwork and sinks mid-range jumpers with ice in its veins. It is known for arriving in very bold outfits.

comp.name: Persian
comp.why: Sleek, stylish, and slips away from anyone.

athletes.name: Victor Wembanyama
athletes.bio: Over seven feet tall with the moves of a guard. Researchers believe it came from another planet. It swats shots from places that should not be possible.

comp.name: Mewtwo
comp.why: Like nothing the league has ever seen.

athletes.name: Luka Dončić
athletes.bio: It lulls defenders to sleep with a slow dribble, then steps back into a shot they never saw coming. It turned pro in Europe as a teenager.

comp.name: Hypno
comp.why: Hypnotizes defenders before the step-back.

athletes.name: Stephen Curry
athletes.bio: It fires water cannons from far beyond the arc and changed how the game is played. Even at an advanced age, a single hot streak can flood an arena.

comp.name: Blastoise
comp.why: Long-range cannons that never stop firing.

athletes.name: Jayson Tatum
athletes.bio: A long, polished wing that scores from every level and defends multiple positions. It has already raised a championship banner.

comp.name: Hitmonchan
comp.why: Polished technique and a complete set of moves.

athletes.name: Anthony Edwards
athletes.bio: Brash, loud, and explosive, it dunks on anyone who stands in its way and tells them about it afterward. Its confidence burns hotter than any arena.

comp.name: Primeape
comp.why: Fiery energy and a fearless attitude.

athletes.name: Joel Embiid
athletes.bio: A giant from Central Africa that once played volleyball and soccer. When healthy, it is an unstoppable force in the post who fans were told to trust.

comp.name: Rhydon
comp.why: Massive, armored, and dominant near the basket.

athletes.name: Jalen Brunson
athletes.bio: Small for its position, it uses low-to-the-ground footwork to burrow into the paint. In the fourth quarter its shots turn ice cold for the other team.

comp.name: Marowak
comp.why: Undersized but gritty and battle-tested.

athletes.name: Donovan Mitchell
athletes.bio: Its nickname comes from a crawling creature, but its game is pure electricity. It explodes to the rim and has exploded for 70 points in a single night.

comp.name: Pikachu
comp.why: Small, electric, and a fan favorite.

athletes.name: Tyrese Haliburton
athletes.bio: Born on a day that only exists every four years, it sends passes soaring the length of the court. It hit several game-winners in one unforgettable playoff run.

comp.name: Fearow
comp.why: Long wingspan and sends the ball flying.

athletes.name: Cade Cunningham
athletes.bio: A big, unhurried point guard that carried a rebuilding franchise back into the light. It grows stronger every season and controls the pace of every game.

comp.name: Kadabra
comp.why: Already powerful and still on the way to its final form.

athletes.name: Jaylen Brown
athletes.bio: Muscular and relentless, it attacks the rim in straight lines and doesn't back down from contact. It once claimed a Finals MVP trophy before moving down the coast to a new home.

comp.name: Machoke
comp.why: Strong, physical, and built to attack.

athletes.name: Devin Booker
athletes.bio: Even in the desert heat its jumper flows like water. It once poured in 70 points in a single game as a young pup.

comp.name: Golduck
comp.why: Smooth, skilled, and full of buckets.

athletes.name: Kevin Durant
athletes.bio: Tall and thin as a shadow, it rises over defenders and its shot simply cannot be blocked. It has haunted defenses for nearly two decades.

comp.name: Gengar
comp.why: A ghostly scorer nobody can stop.

athletes.name: Paolo Banchero
athletes.bio: A strong young forward that plows through defenders on the way to the rim. It was the top pick of its draft class and keeps getting stronger.

comp.name: Nidorino
comp.why: Powerful and still evolving into a king.

athletes.name: Bam Adebayo
athletes.bio: It can guard every position on the floor, from tiny guards to giant centers. Its hard shell is built from a famously tough team culture.

comp.name: Cloyster
comp.why: An almost impenetrable defensive shell.

athletes.name: Chet Holmgren
athletes.bio: Its long, wiry frame stretches toward the rim to erase shots. It can also step out and hit threes, which confuses opposing big men.

comp.name: Onix
comp.why: Long, slender, and blocks everything in its path.

athletes.name: Cooper Flagg
athletes.bio: This prodigy from the northern woods was the number one pick and already does a bit of everything. Experts say it is only beginning to grow.

comp.name: Dratini
comp.why: Rare young talent destined to become a superstar.

athletes.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
athletes.bio: A giant that floats out to the three-point line and shoots like a guard. Few creatures its size have ever had such a soft touch.

comp.name: Lapras
comp.why: A gentle giant that glides across the water.

athletes.name: Klay Thompson
athletes.bio: Half of a legendary splash duo, it once scored 37 points in a single quarter. It loves cruising on its boat, and after years by the bay it now soaks up the sun in a beach town.

comp.name: Psyduck
comp.why: Seems laid-back, then erupts with sudden, unstoppable power.

athletes.name: Patrick Mahomes
athletes.bio: It throws sidearm, no-look, and on the run, often all in the same game. Its father was a big-league pitcher, which may explain the arm.

comp.name: Alakazam
comp.why: Genius-level mind that solves any defense.

athletes.name: Josh Allen
athletes.bio: A huge-armed passer that would rather hurdle or truck a linebacker than slide. It thrives in blizzards near a great lake.

comp.name: Tauros
comp.why: Charges ahead and runs people over.

athletes.name: Lamar Jackson
athletes.bio: The most dangerous runner ever to play its position. Defenders who try to tackle it often grab only the air where it was a moment ago.

comp.name: Electrode
comp.why: Explosive and among the fastest of its kind.

athletes.name: Joe Burrow
athletes.bio: Nothing rattles it. It arrives at stadiums in stylish outfits and dark sunglasses, then picks apart defenses with surgical calm.

comp.name: Articuno
comp.why: A legendary bird made of pure cool.

athletes.name: Jalen Hurts
athletes.bio: Squat, strong, and stoic. Short-yardage plays seem hopeless for defenses, because its team simply shoves it forward until it crosses the line.

comp.name: Rhyhorn
comp.why: Charges forward in a straight line and can't be stopped.

athletes.name: Brock Purdy
athletes.bio: It was the very last pick of its draft class, a title meant to be a joke. It grew steadily and calmly into a franchise starter anyway.

comp.name: Bulbasaur
comp.why: The humble starter that keeps growing.

athletes.name: Justin Jefferson
athletes.bio: Its routes are so sharp they slice cornerbacks in half. After a big catch, it celebrates with a famous dance.

comp.name: Scyther
comp.why: Razor-sharp cuts and blinding speed.

athletes.name: Ja'Marr Chase
athletes.bio: Catch a short pass, break one tackle, and suddenly it's gone in a streak of flame. It shares a special bond with its college quarterback.

comp.name: Flareon
comp.why: Burns hot after the catch.

athletes.name: CeeDee Lamb
athletes.bio: It wears a legendary number for its famous franchise and plays with a showman's flair. It is a magnet for targets on every down.

comp.name: Rapidash
comp.why: Flashy, fast, and blazing down the field.

athletes.name: Puka Nacua
athletes.bio: Overlooked until late in its draft, it went on to break rookie records. It catches everything and loves to throw blocks.

comp.name: Kingler
comp.why: Crushing grip and loves contact.

athletes.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
athletes.bio: It carries a nickname tied to the sun and keeps a list of every receiver drafted before it. It attacks the middle of the field with a relentless motor.

comp.name: Beedrill
comp.why: Relentless, swarming, never stops working.

athletes.name: Saquon Barkley
athletes.bio: It once hurdled a defender backwards, without even looking. It flew past 2,000 rushing yards in a single season.

comp.name: Dragonite
comp.why: Powerful body that can still take flight.

athletes.name: Derrick Henry
athletes.bio: A huge back with a famously devastating stiff-arm. It grows stronger as the game goes on, and defenders dread tackling it in the fourth quarter.

comp.name: Nidoking
comp.why: A king that bulldozes everything in its path.

athletes.name: Bijan Robinson
athletes.bio: Defenders swear they had it wrapped up, but it phases through tackles like a spirit. It wears a number rarely seen on running backs.

comp.name: Haunter
comp.why: Slips through tackles like it isn't there.

athletes.name: Christian McCaffrey
athletes.bio: It runs inside, catches passes like a wide receiver, and reads blocks perfectly. Its father caught passes in the league too.

comp.name: Eevee
comp.why: Adapts into whatever form the offense needs.

athletes.name: Brock Bowers
athletes.bio: It broke rookie receiving records for its position in its very first season. It blocks like a lineman and runs like a receiver.

comp.name: Poliwrath
comp.why: A muscular swimmer that's both strong and quick.

athletes.name: Myles Garrett
athletes.bio: A rare beast with impossible size and speed. It writes poetry and studies dinosaurs in its spare time, and it recently migrated west to terrorize a new set of quarterbacks.

comp.name: Gyarados
comp.why: Furious, unstoppable rampage off the edge.

athletes.name: Aidan Hutchinson
athletes.bio: Born and raised near the city it now defends, it clamps onto quarterbacks with a relentless motor. It plays every snap like it's personal.

comp.name: Pinsir
comp.why: Crushing grip that wraps up quarterbacks.

athletes.name: Patrick Surtain II
athletes.bio: It shadows the best receiver on every team and sticks to him like a magnet. Its father was also a star cornerback.

comp.name: Magneton
comp.why: Locks on and won't let go.

athletes.name: Brandon Aubrey
athletes.bio: Once a professional soccer player, it now drills kicks from more than 60 yards with ice in its veins. Opposing coaches start worrying once it crosses midfield.

comp.name: Hitmonlee
comp.why: The legendary kicking specialist.

athletes.name: Connor McDavid
athletes.bio: The fastest creature on ice. It carries the puck at full speed in a way that leaves defenders frozen and broadcasters out of words.

comp.name: Zapdos
comp.why: A legendary bolt of lightning.

athletes.name: Leon Draisaitl
athletes.bio: A big centre from Germany with a one-timer from its off wing that slices through goalies. It scores in bunches every spring.

comp.name: Kabutops
comp.why: Slashing blades and a lethal shot.

athletes.name: Nathan MacKinnon
athletes.bio: It burns with an intensity teammates call scary. Each rush builds like a fire racing down a mountain slope.

comp.name: Magmar
comp.why: Burning intensity on every shift.

athletes.name: Auston Matthews
athletes.bio: Raised in the desert, far from any frozen pond, it became the most feared sniper in hockey. It once scored 69 goals in a season.

comp.name: Seadra
comp.why: Fires shots with pinpoint accuracy.

athletes.name: Sidney Crosby
athletes.bio: Captain since it was barely an adult, it has led its kind for two decades. Its number matches its birthday.

comp.name: Venusaur
comp.why: A fully evolved original that never fades.

athletes.name: Nikita Kucherov
athletes.bio: Quiet and mysterious, it disguises every pass as a shot and every shot as a pass. Goalies rarely know which is coming.

comp.name: Mr. Mime
comp.why: Master of illusions with the puck.

athletes.name: Cale Makar
athletes.bio: It skates so smoothly that it seems to melt into the ice. A defender by title, it attacks like a forward.

comp.name: Vaporeon
comp.why: So fluid it seems to dissolve into the ice.

athletes.name: Kirill Kaprizov
athletes.bio: It appears out of nowhere in front of the net, scores, and vanishes again. It became a legend in another league before crossing the ocean.

comp.name: Gastly
comp.why: A sneaky phantom that pops up to score.

athletes.name: David Pastrňák
athletes.bio: Its nickname is a famous noodle dish, and it is known for goofy outfits and a big smile. Its one-timer is no joke.

comp.name: Clefairy
comp.why: Playful and beloved, with surprising power.

athletes.name: Jack Hughes
athletes.bio: One of a set of hockey-playing brothers. Its edgework is so slick that defenders often end up skating the wrong way.

comp.name: Ponyta
comp.why: Young, fast, and full of fire.

athletes.name: Connor Bedard
athletes.bio: It was given special status to join a top junior league at only 15. Its quick-release shot keeps growing stronger.

comp.name: Charmander
comp.why: Young flame destined to become something huge.

athletes.name: Igor Shesterkin
athletes.bio: It guards the net with lightning reflexes and a hard shell. Shooters sometimes skate away shaking their heads in disbelief.

comp.name: Omastar
comp.why: Hard shell and lightning-quick tentacles.

athletes.name: Andrei Vasilevskiy
athletes.bio: Nicknamed after a big jungle cat, it fills the whole net. It has backstopped multiple championship runs.

comp.name: Graveler
comp.why: A rock-solid wall that doesn't move.

athletes.name: Matthew Tkachuk
athletes.bio: It gets under opponents' skin, chirping them all game until they snap. Its father and brother also play the same physical style.

comp.name: Arbok
comp.why: An intimidating pest that wears you down.

athletes.name: Brady Tkachuk
athletes.bio: It parks itself in front of the net and refuses to be moved. After forcing its way out of its old den, it now shares a locker room with its older brother.

comp.name: Mankey
comp.why: Quick to anger and always ready to fight.

athletes.name: Mitch Marner
athletes.bio: It threads passes through tiny gaps that seem impossible. It left its hometown team and headed for the desert lights.

comp.name: Abra
comp.why: Teleports the puck to open teammates.

athletes.name: Jack Eichel
athletes.bio: A big, complete centre that does a bit of everything. It overcame a serious neck injury and then lifted the championship trophy.

comp.name: Dodrio
comp.why: Three heads, three skills, all at once.

athletes.name: Zach Werenski
athletes.bio: It logs huge minutes and pushes the play forward like a rising tide. It became the heart of its team through a very hard time.

comp.name: Poliwhirl
comp.why: A tireless swimmer that never leaves the water.

athletes.name: Macklin Celebrini
athletes.bio: A first-overall pick whose father worked as a team trainer in another sport. It grows into a franchise leader faster than anyone expected.

comp.name: Ivysaur
comp.why: Rapidly growing toward its final form.

athletes.name: Kyle Connor
athletes.bio: Quiet and steady, it scores 40 goals in one of the coldest cities in the league with very little noise. Its release is smooth as a stream.

comp.name: Staryu
comp.why: Quiet, steady, and always on target.
